text_block_list.text:
At Jungle Pocket's request, we went out 
wherever her whims took her today, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh, this view... Ah, I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A few times on away trips back in the day. 
Man, a whole lot went down on this turf!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, since we came all this way, let's go 
pay those folks a little "visit"!

text_block_list.name: Team Member A
text_block_list.text: Jungle Pocket!? What... Why are you...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo! I knew you'd be here! How've you guys 
been?

text_block_list.name: Team Member B
text_block_list.text:
Tch...... What kind of nerve do you have 
coming in here?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'who'? It's a face you 
guys know too. Did you forget?

text_block_list.name: Team Member A
text_block_list.text:
Stop talking like that! This is a course 
for free racers!! Someone who's gone soft 
in the Twinkle Series like you has no—

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare pull such lame stunts, you 
hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Team Member B
text_block_list.text: L-Leader...?!

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
If you've got a complaint, let your 
running do the talking... That's how free 
racers roll, ain't it? Right, Pokke?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah. ...Let's get this started.

And so, the two had a race on a nostalgic 
course. The outcome was—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I won... right? Isn't the finish line 
kinda hard to see?

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Damn it... Are you 
really bringing that up again...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The finish line's impossible to see!! Draw 
a proper line, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
I drew it properly! Didn't you just erase 
it completely?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? It's your own fault for not 
drawing it properly!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just watch! I'll draw the real finish line 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: And the line you drew was all squiggly!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, that happened! And from there, it 
turned into a battle to see who could draw 
the straightest line!

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: ...I'm watching your race.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: ...You've changed in a lot of ways.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
The way she uses her body, the sharpness 
of her stride. Above all, her eyes are 
different—

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: The glare... it's so blinding.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
That's why they... and me too. You've 
changed, and you're shining so brightly. 
That's why we pushed you away...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I don't really care.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text: I see... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
"Still, man... That face of yours hasn't 
changed one bit from back in the day, has 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
That brutally honest side of ya that can't 
hide its obsession with being 'the 
strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, calling me an idiot was totally 
uncalled for.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
Pokke... I don't give a damn how much you 
change, but—

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever 'that' was that beat us... stick 
with it all the way to the very end."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it even without you tellin' me 
to.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, time to get out of here. Never feels 
quite right hangin' out on someone else's 
turf.

time.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, in that case, I've got a killer 
story for ya. Back in the day, she got 
cocky and ate these spicy snacks—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!? You tricked them into eating 
that!! Hey, don't take it seriously!"

Afterward, I was treated to old stories 
that you'd never hear from Jungle Pocket 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
They won't be coming for a while. These 
guys need some prep time to get stronger 
too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
Talk all you want. I can't wait to break 
the nose of the "strongest" right off her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...See ya.
